rules.title: SERVER RULES
rules.subtitle: The code of conduct that governs the PlayCrows realm.

items.title: Respect All Players
rules: Harassment, discrimination, hate speech, or excessive toxicity will not be tolerated.

items.title: No Exploiting or Bug Abuse
rules: Exploiting game bugs or unintended mechanics for personal gain is prohibited.
Any discovered bugs should be reported immediately.

items.title: No Third-Party Programs
rules: The use of cheats, hacks, bots, macros, scripts, or unauthorized third-party software that provides an unfair advantage is strictly prohibited.

items.title: No Account Trading or Selling
rules: Buying, selling, sharing, or trading accounts is done entirely at your own risk.
PlayCrows is not responsible for any losses resulting from account sharing or trading.

items.title: Impersonation
rules: Pretending to be a Game Master (GM), Administrator, Moderator, or any PlayCrows staff member is prohibited.

items.title: Respect the Community
rules: Do not intentionally disrupt gameplay, events, or community activities.
Follow instructions given by PlayCrows staff when necessary.

warningSystem.heading: ⚠️ Warning System
warningSystem.intro: PlayCrows uses a <0>3-Warning Policy</0> for most rule violations.
items: Each valid video evidence submitted and verified by the staff counts as one (1) warning.
Players can accumulate a maximum of three (3) warnings.
Upon receiving the third warning, the account will be permanently banned.
All verified warnings will be publicly listed on the official PlayCrows website for transparency.

zeroTolerance.heading: 🚫 Zero-Tolerance Violations
zeroTolerance.intro: The following offenses result in an <0>immediate permanent ban</0> without any warnings:
speedHackLines: The use of any speed modification, speed hack, or movement manipulation software is strictly forbidden.
Once verified, the account will receive an immediate permanent ban.

permanentBanPolicy.heading: 🔒 Permanent Ban Policy
lines: Once an account has been permanently banned, the decision is final.
Permanent bans are not eligible for appeal.
Creating alternative accounts to bypass a permanent ban may result in additional enforcement actions.

evidenceRequirements.heading: 📹 Evidence Requirements
lines: Video evidence must clearly show the offense.
Edited, manipulated, or incomplete recordings may be rejected.
PlayCrows staff reserves the right to determine whether submitted evidence is valid.

rules.footerNote: ⚖️ These rules exist to maintain a fair and competitive environment for everyone. By playing on PlayCrows, you acknowledge and agree to follow all server rules and understand that staff decisions regarding rule enforcement are final. Thank you for helping us build a better PlayCrows community.
